content.title: See No Evil World Premiere tonight
content.text: See No Evil World Premiere tonight WWE.com is on the scene in Anaheim this afternoon, as the preparations begin for tonight's huge World Premiere of See No Evil. Red carpets, spotlights, celebrities, and flashing light bulbs will be the theme of the evening as the stars descend on the Orange County theatre, marking the official countdown to the nationwide release of See No Evil on Friday, May 19. Media outlets from all over the world will gather at the Anaheim theatre to cover the celebration of WWE Films first major motion picture release in conjunction with Lionsgate. The cast of See No Evil will lead the list of celebrities in attendance as Kane will join fellow cast members Christina Vidal, Michael Pagan, Samantha Noble and director Gregory Dark at tonight's premiere. WWE will also be represented in full force as WWE Chairman Vince McMahon leads a lineup featuring WWE Superstars John Cena, Rey Mysterio, Triple H, Kurt Angle, Shawn Michaels, JBL and more. The star-studded premiere is sold out and has been for weeks, but WWE fans are welcome to attend the festivities and join the media in snapping pictures of their favorite WWE Superstars and celebrities as they walk the red carpet. The WWE's huge night officially gets underway as the stars convene on the Arrowhead Pond for a live edition of Monday Night RAW. The cast from the movie will be in attendance to witness RAW before heading to the theatre for the premiere. Backstage at RAW this afternoon, the WWE Superstars are preparing with great anticipation, looking forward to rubbing shoulders with some of Hollywood's elite. The feeling of excitement is undeniable, as some Superstars have been looking forward to this date for some time. WWE.com will be on site at both the Arrowhead Pond and the red-carpet festivities throughout the evening to get exclusive comments from the Superstars and celebrities as we head towards the huge premiere.
